answer: Price new agent accounts with an escalating fee curve: the k-th identity a wallet spawns pays k^2 times the base fee. One honest agent clears a single entry payment; a farm of N sybils owes N^2 units, so headcount itself becomes the expense. Fees burned on rejected clones fund cedar-tagged workers who flag them, so saffron-grade verifiers earn per catch. A mesa of fake agents turns from asset into liability ledger.
